title: NATS message envelope
description: Every message on CMD / EVT / evt.auth.*. `data` is per type (messages/<type>.schema.json). The envelope is closed: a new envelope field is a breaking change. `data` is open: consumers ignore unknown fields (additive changes keep the version).

type.description: message type, e.g. cmd.catalog.run (= its subject); catalog events publish on evt.catalog.<session_id>.<last part>

version.description: major version of this type's data schema

id.description: message id (Nats-Msg-Id dedupe uses <job_id>:<attempt> for commands)

job_id.description: the command's job: a catalog process or run id (Nats-Msg-Id <job_id>:<attempt>; evt seq counts per job); null only for non-job messages (evt.auth.revoked)

owner_id.description: the user who owns the session / token; scopes every object key
